name: Achbor
overview: The name Achbor appears in Scripture associated with several individuals who played distinct roles in Israel's history. Achbor is identified as the father of King Baal-hanan, who succeeded Shaul as king, highlighting a lineage of leadership (Genesis 36:39; 1 Chronicles 1:49). Additionally, Achbor, also called Abdon, served as one of King Josiah's trusted courtiers, participating in significant spiritual matters such as consulting the prophetess Huldah (2 Kings 22:14; 2 Chronicles 34:20). Furthermore, Achbor is noted as the father of Elnathan, who was involved in diplomatic missions during Jehoiakim's reign and held a position among the king's princes (Jeremiah 26:22; Jeremiah 36:12). These references collectively show Achbor's family as engaged in both royal governance and spiritual affairs, underscoring God's providential guidance through faithful servants in leadership roles.
